## Kind of change

- [ ] Language / spec
- [ ] Compiler bug fix
- [ ] Optimizer

## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo test` passes
- [ ] `docs/language.md` / `docs/grammar.md` updated if syntax changed
- [ ] `docs/status.md` notes the limitation or feature
- [ ] New behaviour has a test (unit, e2e, or fuzz seed)
- [ ] No new crates.io dependency
